# DISTRICT 88 LTD

> DISTRICT 88 LTD is a premium garment development and manufacturing partner headquartered in Hong Kong, with operations in Shanghai and Hangzhou, China. The company supports international fashion, sportswear, cycling, technical apparel, and swimwear brands from tech pack development and material sourcing through sampling, bulk production, quality control, and export coordination.

## Key facts

- Legal name: DISTRICT 88 LTD
- Type: B2B garment development & manufacturing (OEM / private label)
- Head office: Unit No. 532B, 5/F, Star House, No. 3 Salisbury Road, Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong
- China operations: Shanghai and Hangzhou, Zhejiang
- Contact: contact@district-88.com
- Markets served: international brands worldwide
- Product categories: Fashion & Lifestyle, Sportswear, Cycling, Technical Apparel, Swimwear

## Services

- Product development (pattern making, grading, construction solutions)
- Material sourcing (fabrics, trims, accessories; organic cotton available when certified)
- Sampling (prototypes, fittings, iterative adjustments)
- Pre-production (final specifications, materials, colors, details)
- Manufacturing at scale (delicate fashion garments to complex technical sportswear)
- Quality control (measurements, construction, finishing, packaging — integrated at every stage)
- Packaging & export coordination (private label packaging, international dispatch)

## Materials expertise

- Cotton & blends: premium jersey, heavyweight cotton, French Terry, fleece
- Performance synthetics: polyester, nylon, elastane blends, specialized mesh
- Technical textiles: quick-dry, moisture-wicking, breathable membranes, 4-way stretch

## Pages

- [Home](https://district-88.com/): positioning, process overview, product categories
- [Capabilities](https://district-88.com/capabilities): category-by-category manufacturing expertise
- [Services](https://district-88.com/services): end-to-end manufacturing services
- [Materials](https://district-88.com/materials): fabric and material expertise
- [Our Work](https://district-88.com/our-work): selected projects and brand partnerships
- [FAQ](https://district-88.com/faq): minimum order quantities, timelines, sampling, quality control, compliance
- [About](https://district-88.com/about): company background and locations
- [Contact](https://district-88.com/contact): project brief form and direct contact
